response.overview: By way of defense, an anecdote drifts in amidst the starlings—  scarcely any other sound—  a man who lost his way here—not in the woods, among the trees,  but in the description of a man he might also have been  a father waking up to search for his children  among the suitcases in the hallway  a man pulling the forest shut behind him  after burying the remnants of winter  amidst bushes over which a flock of habits flies  It is a game, yes—dead serious—  I seek the man he was, without hurting either of us  and then the game ends as a children’s game ends  when the authorities say it is time to disperse  when that same man gets into his car and one person remains.
response.title: Zwermen
